author: vivinancy
name: Verification
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Verification!
Run `[p]verifyset settings` to begin, then `[p]verifyset toggle` once configured.
short: Protect your community from unwanted bots by enforcing verification for new members.
description: Gate new members behind an image captcha in a dedicated channel, with configurable roles to add and remove on success.
end_user_data_statement: This cog temporarily stores the Discord user ID, a generated verification code, an attempt count, and an expiry timestamp for members currently undergoing verification. This data is deleted when verification completes, expires, or the member leaves the server.
